{{Top|leg}}
A '''gremlin''' was a supposed creature that caused malfunctions in underwater airlocks, following the theory of the superstitious [[The "Half Under" population|"Half Under" population]] of [[Bartyn's Landing]]. The people behind these sabotages were really the thought-extinct [[Menahuun]].

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] referred to the Ewoks who surrounded him after he fell from their net on the Forest Moon of Endor as "Axe-wielding gremlins".<ref>[[Return of the Jedi (radio)|''Return of the Jedi'' radio drama]] - "[[So Turns a Galaxy, So Turns a Wheel]]"</ref>
